subject: Application for Junior Python Developer - Berat Altinsuyu
email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Junior Python Developer position at Antigravity Corp. As a Computer Engineering student with a solid background in backend development and a focus on building robust APIs, I am confident that my technical skills and project experience make me a great fit for your team.

During my internship at VakıfBank in the Payment Systems department, I gained hands-on experience developing RESTful APIs using .NET Core, performing SQL operations, and validating data flows. Furthermore, my academic and personal projects—including a full-stack restaurant POS system—have allowed me to work extensively with database management, real-time data updates, and API integration. While my professional background includes .NET, I have actively developed projects using Python and FastAPI, and I am eager to apply my backend expertise to the challenges at Antigravity Corp.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of your focus on scalable backend architecture. I have attached my CV for your review and would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my technical background and problem-solving skills can contribute to the success of your development team.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

Berat Altinsuyu
